description: Use when someone asks for their feng shui kua number, East or West group, or favourable directions from a birth date. It reports what the Eight Mansions school says; feng shui is a tradition, not a science.

birth_date.description: The birth date, YYYY-MM-DD, from 1901 to 2099.

birth_time.description: Optional: the local birth time, HH:MM. It matters only on the day of Li Chun (about 4 February).

formula.description: both, female or male: the tradition has one formula for each sex at birth.

utc_offset_minutes.description: The birth place’s offset from UTC in early February, in minutes (0 for the UK, 480 for China) (minutes).
